---
title: Gallery
subtitle: "Several widgets on one page, spread out so you can scroll between them."
format: html
---

Scroll down slowly and watch the Performance panel (or just
`ERGMQuarto.instances.map(r => r.widget._visible)` in the console): each
widget only spins up its sigma renderer and animation loop once it
scrolls into view, and stops again once it scrolls back out. This page has
no reveal.js, so `ergm-widget.js` falls back to its `IntersectionObserver`
branch.
